title: cachegen elaborated configuration
description: The complete solve, written next to the emitted RTL. Machine-produced; never hand-edited. Contains the input verbatim, every derived field, the provenance record, and the manifest of what was emitted. This is the file a task's Results Capture cites.

provenance.description: Everything needed to reproduce this run and to prove a later run used the same inputs.

input_sha256.description: Digest of the input JSON as read, after extraction from its containing document if it was fenced.

source_document.description: Path and fence label when the input was extracted from a planning document rather than read as a standalone file.

input.description: The input configuration verbatim, after defaults are applied. Present so the elaborated file stands alone.

derived.description: Everything computed from the input. No value here is a decision.

bytes_per_way.description: capacity_bytes / associativity. The quantity the VIPT constraint bounds.

overhead_bits.description: Tag, valid, dirty and replacement state, summed. The cost not counted in capacity_bytes.

tree_depth.description: log2(associativity) for tree_plru. Absent for other policies.

update_table.description: Per-way update rule, generated from the tree construction rather than transcribed. Index is the way. Each entry gives, per state bit, the value written: 0, 1, or hold.

victim_table.description: State value to victim way. Index is the state value. Generated, not transcribed. This table and update_table are the two things most often wrong when written by hand.

blocking.description: True when mshrs is 0. Selects the blocking FSM emitter instead of the non-blocking one.

vipt.description: Present only when indexing is VIPT.

index_offset_budget_used.description: index_bits + offset_bits. Must not exceed page_offset_bits.

budget_headroom_bits.description: page_offset_bits minus the budget used. Zero means the geometry sits exactly at the limit and any increase in capacity per way introduces synonyms.

translated_index_bits.description: Index bits taken from above the page offset. Nonzero means synonyms are possible; the tool rejects this under alias_policy forbid.

address_map.description: Rendered address field diagram, for the datasheet and the emitted header comment.

manifest.description: Every file written, with a digest. Regeneration compares against this to produce a diff review rather than a blind overwrite.

module.description: SystemVerilog module or package name, when the file declares one.

checks.description: Every constraint the tool evaluated that the input schema cannot express. Recorded pass or fail so the record shows what was checked, not only that generation succeeded.

make_targets.description: Targets present in the emitted Makefile. The task that runs this generation runs every one of them; this list is what it enumerates against.

field.description: One address field. All four values are redundant with each other by construction; they are emitted together because the RTL, the model and the datasheet each want a different one, and deriving them separately is how they drift.
